claim_boundary: Literature/corpus synthesis and finite-window analysis only. No claim for or against RH.
target: A manifestly positive Markov/conditional-expectation/Gibbs semigroup in log-scale whose reflection is the functional equation and whose generator itself carries the zeta ordinates; equivalently an independently derived OS Hilbert-Polya operator or the metric inequality L*.

literature.object: Adele-class scaling action and absorption-spectrum trace formula.
literature.positivity: Hilbert-space scaling structure derived; global positivity/trace implication not derived.
literature.unconditional: Spectral interpretation and noncommutative trace-formula framework.
literature.stopping_point: No global Markov/OS construction proving that only critical zeros occur.

literature.positivity: Not imposed; global space is not biased toward the critical line.
literature.unconditional: All zeros and poles occur spectrally and the explicit formula is a character formula.
literature.relation: Spectral realization without the target positivity.

literature.object: Compressed scaling action, Sonin/prolate spaces and semi-local Weil forms.
literature.positivity: Derived at the single archimedean place; not globally.
literature.unconditional: Archimedean positivity mechanism and semi-local operator framework.
literature.relation: Operator stage close to the target.

literature.object: Finite self-adjoint rank-one perturbations of log-scaling spectral triples.
literature.positivity: Finite self-adjointness derived by operator/Caratheodory-Fejer methods.
literature.unconditional: Finite operators with numerical spectra tracking low zeta ordinates.
literature.stopping_point: Spectral or regularized-determinant convergence to the zeta object is open.

literature.object: Screw kernel, helical embedding and Krein canonical system.
literature.positivity: Global screw-kernel positivity is equivalent to RH.
literature.unconditional: Explicit g; finite-interval trace class; Psi(t)>0 for 0<t<t0 for some t0>log 2; screw-kernel positivity on (-a,a) for some a0>0.
literature.stopping_point: No global positive Hamiltonian is constructed from prime data.

literature.object: Localized Weil operator A_a and finite-interval self-adjoint differential extensions.
literature.positivity: Self-adjointness/lower boundedness are unconditional; positivity only for small a.
literature.unconditional: Explicit Friedrichs realization and continuity of the lowest eigenvalue.
literature.stopping_point: The a-to-infinity convergence producing zeta zeros is conjectural.
literature.relation: Finite real spectra, not yet the zeta spectrum.

literature.object: Entire-function Hilbert spaces and shift positivity.
literature.unconditional: de Branges implication theorem; explicit Conrey-Li counterexample to the shift positivity for E(z)=xi(1-iz).
literature.stopping_point: The natural positivity is strictly stronger than RH and fails for the xi-associated space.
literature.relation: Critical warning about choosing the metric.

literature.object: Conductor operator, co-Poisson and Sonine/de Branges spaces.
literature.unconditional: Local explicit-formula terms and zero-indexed Sonine vectors.
literature.stopping_point: No single global positive generator has the zeta zeros as point spectrum.

sources: H. Yoshida, Adv. Stud. Pure Math. 21 (1992), 281-325
literature.object: Localized Weil form, variational operator and Li coefficients.
literature.positivity: Weil positivity is directly derived on small supports; all-index Li positivity is equivalent to RH.
literature.unconditional: Positivity for supp(f) in [-L,L] when 2L <= log 2; finite reduction and minimizers; finite Li tables reach thousands, not a theorem near 100000.
literature.stopping_point: No all-window/all-index or growing-window lower bound.
literature.relation: Classical unconditional compact range plus a discrete criterion.

literature.object: Foliated flows, Lefschetz trace and would-be arithmetic cohomology.
literature.positivity: Geometric Hodge positivity exists for actual foliations; the arithmetic realization is missing.
literature.unconditional: Trace formulas for specified foliated flows and comparison with adelic spaces.
literature.stopping_point: No arithmetic foliation/cohomology with the required polarization.
literature.relation: Geometric template, not a zeta generator.

literature.object: Non-Hermitian xp-type operator, boundary condition and candidate metric.
literature.positivity: Quasi-Hermiticity is required rather than proved in the needed space.
literature.stopping_point: Standard metric completion lacks the candidate eigenstates; no accepted Hilbert-Polya operator.

literature.object: C*-dynamical/KMS system with Hamiltonian log N and partition function zeta(beta).
literature.positivity: Gibbs/KMS positivity and the phase transition are derived.
literature.unconditional: Arithmetic quantum statistical system and symmetry breaking at beta=1.
literature.stopping_point: The generator has log-integer spectrum, not zeta ordinates; no Weil/OS positivity mechanism.
literature.relation: Euler-side thermodynamics, not the target generator.

Form density, spectral-density control and discretization limits.
corpus_contact.target_mapping: Domain/limit bridge; formal Mosco/norm-resolvent and pointwise frame bound remain open in the note's split.

corpus_contact.object: Uniform positivity of the window family/off-line-zero detector.
corpus_contact.target_mapping: Resolved finite band gamma <= pi/D; uniform all-window statement PRIME.UNIFPOS.01 is the conjectural wall.

corpus_contact.object: Transfer from finite families to full Weil positivity.
corpus_contact.target_mapping: Requires W2, scale control and uniformity.

corpus_contact.object: Integral p^2 dnu < integral p^2 dmu for deg p < N_w, equivalently lambda_max(E_Nw) < 1.

corpus_contact.target_mapping: Do not construct Suzuki's continuous positive canonical-system Hamiltonian.

corpus_contact.object: Margin chain, Borodin duality and Dirichlet matched frame.
corpus_contact.target_mapping: Exact reparametrizations and finite censuses; no proof of L*.

corpus_contact.object: Fixed-k inequality proved; augmented-dual-resolvent, selected-grid approximation and quadratic arch-error rate open; countable Gabor criterion equivalent to RH.
corpus_contact.target_mapping: Formal reduction boundary, not a derived positive generator.

g_decomposition.literal_split: g_arch is every non-prime term and g_prime is the positive ramp sum.
g_decomposition.reason: A symmetric atom delta_a+delta_-a has translation-form multiplier 2 cos(a xi), which changes sign. A positive comb in log-position is not a positive convolution quadratic form.

metric_identity.theorem: K_g positive semidefinite iff there is a stationary-increment helical embedding x with <x(t)-x(0),x(u)-x(0)>=K_g(t,u) and ||x(t)-x(0)||^2=-2g(t).
metric_identity.zeta_status: For Suzuki's g, global positivity is equivalent to RH.
metric_identity.lstar_relation: L* is an assembled finite two-measure metric comparison, not a raw arch-minus-prime semidefinite decomposition.

unconditional_range.classical: 2L <= log 2, hence L <= 0.34657359027997265 for supp(f) subset [-L,L].

corpus_range.statement: Q(f) >= 8.9e-18 ||f||_2^2 for supp(f) subset [-0.8,0.8], with upper bound 2.27e-17.
corpus_range.prime_content: log n < 1.6 gives n=2,3,4; not prime 2 only.
corpus_range.comparison: Autocorrelation support 1.6 is about 2.3 times the classical log 2 range.
corpus_range.status: Existing finite RH-neutral preprint theorem; no new probe required.

mechanism_of_window_certificates.finite_height_implication: FALSE for the whole compact-support window class.
mechanism_of_window_certificates.reason: Compact log-support makes the Fourier transform entire of exponential type, not compactly frequency-supported; hypothetical off-line zeros above any finite H remain visible.
mechanism_of_window_certificates.uncertainty_statement: pi/L is a resolution scale only (about 3.93 at L=0.8), not a cutoff. For a finite grid of spacing D, the corpus detector alias band is gamma <= pi/D and still requires a tail bound.
mechanism_of_window_certificates.certificate_provenance: The L=0.8 lower bound is assembled independently from primes, digamma and rigorous finite-matrix/tail estimates.

partial_theorem_or_obstruction.statement: The desired semidefinite arch-minus-prime decomposition is false; compact-window tests see all zero heights; a finite verified-zero height helps only with an additional uniform tail theorem. Uniform W3/W4 or L* is exactly the missing operator/metric estimate.

verdict.summary: No accepted construction has the fixed target shape. Connes/Meyer supply the global scaling/spectral stage, Suzuki supplies the exact screw and localized operators, and 2025-2026 spectral triples supply self-adjoint finite approximants, but every route stops at global positivity or convergence. Conrey-Li shows that a natural operator positivity can be strictly stronger than RH. In the corpus W1 is closed, W2 is a domain/limit bridge, uniform W3 is the positivity wall, W4 is global transfer, and L* is the finite metric gap.
verdict.single_next_action: Prove a geometric/prime-side, uniform-in-scale resolvent or regularized-determinant convergence estimate with an explicit tail norm for the existing D_log^(lambda,N) or Suzuki D_(a,theta) family.
